items.title: Critical Fix: Eliminated Auto-Tracking 'Snap-Back' loop. Go Home and Manual moves now hard-stop auto-tracking (set _user_initiated_stop). Removed _complete_go_home unconditional re-enable callback. User must press Start Tracking to resume. Fixed dual-port _home_step guard to check bus_ser too. Fixed duplicate IO send bug in dual-port (try/except/else was double-sending S/M/F/L/R/G to Nano). Bus servo failures now always logged (not gated by debug checkbox).
Finetuning: Increased 'Go Home' speed (5%→10% default) and speed limit (8→25 deg/sec) for better responsiveness. Updated default Home Tilt to 80° per user request.
Finetuning: Improved auto-track stability with debounce (0.5s) on target loss. Added detailed debug logging for Bus Servo write failures in Dual Port mode.

Critical Fix: 'Home' and 'Stop Tracking' buttons now correctly prevent auto-tracking from immediately re-enabling in YOLO modes. Explicit stop actions are respected until user manually restarts tracking.

Critical Fix: Resolved UI limitation where Home Tilt/Pan inputs were clamped to default ranges (e.g. 70) even when limits were increased. load_settings now updates widget ranges before setting values.

Critical Fix: Resolved resource contention where YOLO detection would override 'Go Home' and 'Manual Set' targets with 'Passive Tracking' updates. Now explicitly gates tracking calculations with 'tracking_active' and blocks idle/hold logic during 'Go Home' moves.
Behavior Presets dock now keeps a stable objectName to prevent saveState/restoreState crashes when layouts are saved or restored.
Go Home completion now restores tracking/aiming when auto-tracking is enabled or when tracking was previously active (prevents autotrack from staying off after homing).

Manual control + Go Home: refresh manual override suppression per button press, prevent YOLO/Hybrid auto-tracking from overriding manual/home moves, force threaded YOLO with shorter async max-age, and avoid sync model loads in update_frame.
UI cleanup: removed unused Workspace dock; Behavior Presets dock stays hidden by default and excluded from saved layouts (still available via Widgets menu).
Presets/defaults now persist motion-gate, detection pause, speed optimization, and scope visual settings; scope visual settings window height reduced.
Auto-fire safety: optional motion-verified gate (UI in Tracking Behavior) to prevent firing on stationary targets. Disabled by default; settings persist via motion_fire_* keys.
Speed optimizations: faster serial cadence, faster bus-servo timing, predictive lead, async YOLO, ROI cropping, light-model preference, and optional redundant-command bypass.
Aiming stability: main app now uses SmartTracker (centroid smoothing + persistence) and avoids ROI centroid drift so the yellow-dot stays centered on the tracked object.
